first_step.title: First Step
first_step.desc: You added your first movie, TV show, or anime. Welcome to the club, rookie.

movies_10.title: The Ten
movies_10.desc: 10 films in your library. Not bad for a start.

tv_10.title: TV Regular
tv_10.desc: 10 TV shows in your library. You know a thing or two about long stories.

anime_10.title: Beginning Otaku
anime_10.desc: 10 anime in your library. Welcome to the club.

not_the_bees.title: "Not the Bees!"
not_the_bees.desc: Witness the legendary masterpiece with Nicolas Cage in a bear suit, beating up women in the woods and screaming about bees in his eyes like it's the performance of a lifetime.

nevsky_absolute.title: "Absolute Cinema"
nevsky_absolute.desc: Watch a film starring Hollywood's greatest Russian hero, where the entire budget went to close-up walking, leather jackets, chicken and rice, and an endless shootout where no one ever gets hit. Wot a wot!

room_wiseau.title: "Oh, hi Mark!"
room_wiseau.desc: Touch the greatest worst film in human history, throw a spoon at the screen, listen to dialogue like "I did not hit her, it's not true, oh hi Mark" and realize this is an absolute genius masterpiece.

green_elephant.title: "Sweet Bread"
green_elephant.desc: Endure the main arthouse of the domestic underground, hear the story about going to work, don't stain the guardhouse and heroically don't delete the app out of horror.

morbius_time.title: "It's Morbin' Time!"
morbius_time.desc: Voluntarily add a film that became such a meme failure that the studio re-released it in theaters twice — and both times crashed at the box office.

cats_horrifying.title: "Digital Nightmare"
cats_horrifying.desc: Endure a two-hour trip with humanoid cats rendered in terrible CGI and try to unsee the flapping cartoon cat anuses the studio had to censor on release.

fast_family.title: "For Family and a 1/4 Mile"
fast_family.desc: Go with tears in your eyes from stealing stereos in beat-up Hondas to flying a muscle car into outer space for the Main Value — Family and a cold Corona.

nolan_time.title: "Nolan Approves"
nolan_time.desc: Close the entire filmography of the Great Genius, break your brain three times on time games, go deaf from Hans Zimmer's soundtrack and proudly pretend you understood everything without YouTube explainers.

sharknado_marathon.title: "Shark Meteorologist"
sharknado_marathon.desc: Survive all six parts of the meaningless hell from The Asylum, where chainsaws and sharks fly in tornadoes eating people mid-air, and the graphics look like they were rendered in a microwave.

marvel_fatigue.title: "Conveyor Belt Victim"
marvel_fatigue.desc: Watch over 30 colorful films about men in latex, sit through 100 hours for three-second post-credit scenes and still sincerely hope the next phase will fix everything.

tarantino_feet.title: "Connoisseur of Female Feet"
tarantino_feet.desc: Close Tarantino's entire filmography, memorize tons of profanity and liters of fake blood, and count every close-up of bare female feet in 4K.

cage_fever.title: "Cage Overload"
cage_fever.desc: Collect 10+ Nicolas Cage films — from absolute Oscar-level masterpieces to pure trash made for a bag of chips just to pay off debts on a purchased castle.

masochist_trash.title: "Masochist-Esthetic"
masochist_trash.desc: Find absolute garbage in the deepest cellars of cinema that makes the whole internet sick, shed a tear of delight and give it 10/10 marked "misunderstood masterpiece ahead of its time".

speedrunner.title: "Binge Maniac"
speedrunner.desc: Close 5 films in one day. Eyes leaking onto the keyboard, ass flat, the real world outside long lost its meaning. Planning to go outside at all?

night_owl.title: "Midnight Screening"
night_owl.desc: Finish a thriller at 4 AM when you have work at 8, and sit in the dark with red eyes pondering the frailty of existence.

marathon_endurance.title: "Ass of Steel"
marathon_endurance.desc: Endure a three-hour cinema monster in one sitting while your glutes fuse with the chair and your bladder passes the ultimate endurance test.

ancient_fossil.title: "Cinema Archaeologist"
ancient_fossil.desc: Dig up and watch a silent or black-and-white film made before your parents or even grandma were born. A pure museum exhibit!

short_and_sweet.title: "Micro-Screening"
short_and_sweet.desc: Watch a feature film shorter than the drawn-out intros in episodes of shows like Stranger Things. Quick, cheap, brutal!

uwe_boll_survivor.title: "Uwe Boll Survivor"
uwe_boll_survivor.desc: Heroically endure 3 video game adaptations from the maestro who made films purely for German tax breaks and challenged critics to a real boxing ring.

snob_critic.title: "Merciless Critic"
snob_critic.desc: Give a 1/10 rating to 5 films in a row. No mercy for directors, writers and actors — today a real executioner rules the cinema!

potterhead.title: "Head Gryffindor"
potterhead.desc: Watch all 8 films about the boy who lived, forgive the filmmakers for cutting Peeves, learn all the spells and still wait for your Hogwarts letter after 30 years.

lotr_ringbearer.title: "Ring Bearer"
lotr_ringbearer.desc: Carry the ring from the Shire to Orodruin with Frodo and Sam, endure 12 hours of runtime and realize that eagles are the most useless birds in the universe since they couldn't just fly there.

matrix_redpill.title: "Red Pill"
matrix_redpill.desc: Go from the great first film in a leather coat to the fourth part and realize that Agent Smith was the only normal dude in this digital madness.

saw_game.title: "Jigsaw's Victim"
saw_game.desc: Survive all of Jigsaw's traps, hear "I want to play a game" 100 times and stop being scared of blood because in the later parts it's just cranberry syrup.

starwars_boomer.title: "Came, Saw, Turned to the Dark Side"
starwars_boomer.desc: Watch all three trilogies, survive Anakin's fall, get through the Disney episodes, cry over the franchise's fate and realize that Jar Jar Binks is the true Sith Lord.

shrek_swamp.title: "This Is My Swamp!"
shrek_swamp.desc: Spend a weekend in the swamp with a green ogre and a talking donkey, memorize the entire Smash Mouth — All Star soundtrack and demand "Shrek 5" right now!

alien_chestburster.title: "Facehugger Allergy"
alien_chestburster.desc: Watch all of Ripley's adventures and the traitorous androids, learn to check the ventilation before sleep and never touch suspicious eggs in the basement again.

terminator_fates.title: "I Need Your Motorcycle"
terminator_fates.desc: Rewatch the perfect first two parts, then heroically push through a bunch of crappy sequels with liquid robots and an aged Arnie. Hasta la vista, backend!

pirates_rum.title: "Where's the Rum?!"
pirates_rum.desc: Sail under Captain Jack Sparrow's flag through all 5 films, memorize Hans Zimmer's main theme and realize that drinking rum at 10 AM is a perfectly normal maritime tradition.

transformers_bayhem.title: "Michael Bay Epilepsy"
transformers_bayhem.desc: Endure 15 hours of endless explosions, spinning metal, US flags at sunset and Megan Fox screaming. Your ophthalmologist is crying with you.

john_wick_pencil.title: "Pencil Killer"
john_wick_pencil.desc: Count all 500+ corpses shot by Keanu Reeves for revenge for a dog and a car, and remember: a simple office pencil is a weapon of mass destruction.

resident_evil_milla.title: "Milla Jovovich's Victim"
resident_evil_milla.desc: Watch 6 parts in a row as Milla Jovovich in a beautiful latex outfit roundhouse kicks zombies and dogs in the face while the plot finally turns into an incoherent trip by director Paul W. S. Anderson.

twilight_vampire.title: "Team Edward"
twilight_vampire.desc: Voluntarily swallow all parts of the love triangle between an emo vampire, pale Bella and a buff werewolf who constantly walks around without a shirt. But he sparkles in the sun!

final_destination.title: "Fear of Logs on the Highway"
final_destination.desc: Watch all the elaborate ways Death takes teenagers, get a lifelong phobia of logging trucks on the highway, tanning beds and laser eye surgery.

godfather_offer.title: "An Offer You Can't Refuse"
godfather_offer.desc: Immerse yourself in the Sicilian mafia drama for 9 hours, pet the cat with Marlon Brando, learn the laws of the Corleone family and never go against your own.

mission_impossible_stunt.title: "Tom Cruise Without a Stunt Double"
mission_impossible_stunt.desc: Watch Tom Cruise jump off cliffs on a motorcycle, hang on the wing of a taking-off plane and cling to a skyscraper in Dubai without stuntmen while the entire crew's hair turns grey.

hunger_games_mockingjay.title: "Mockingjay"
hunger_games_mockingjay.desc: Survive the Capitol arena, shoot a bow with Katniss, go through a teenage revolution and attend a ballet with President Snow.

halloween_myers.title: "Uninvited Guest with a Knife"
halloween_myers.desc: Endure an endless marathon with a silent man in a blue jumpsuit and white mask who walks but somehow always catches up with running victims.

ocean_eleven_heist.title: "Ocean's Eleven"
ocean_eleven_heist.desc: Rob the most secure casinos in Las Vegas with George Clooney and Brad Pitt while Brad Pitt constantly eats something on screen throughout all three films.

madagascar_smile_and_wave.title: "Smile and Wave!"
madagascar_smile_and_wave.desc: Escape from Central Park Zoo, throw wild dances to I Like to Move It with Julien and pay tribute to the elite penguin special forces.

scream_ghostface.title: "What's Your Favorite Scary Movie?"
scream_ghostface.desc: Answer the call of the maniac in the white mask, go through all horror cliches, guess the killer before the final twist and learn the main rule: never say "I'll be right back".

predator_hunter.title: "Prey for the Hunter"
predator_hunter.desc: Cover yourself in mud from head to toe, learn the phrase "If it bleeds, we can kill it" and follow the evolution of an alien hunter with a thermal vision icon.

evil_dead_groovy.title: "Groovy, Baby!"
evil_dead_groovy.desc: Attach a chainsaw instead of a severed hand, read the Necronomicon spell (without mistakes!) and start a real bloody mess in a forest cabin.

ghostbusters_proton.title: "Who You Gonna Call?"
ghostbusters_proton.desc: Charge the proton pack, cross the streams against safety rules and beat up the Stay Puft Marshmallow Man to the legendary 80s soundtrack.

rocky_balboa_eye.title: "Eye of the Tiger"
rocky_balboa_eye.desc: Drink a raw egg for breakfast, run up the Philadelphia Museum of Art steps, endure 12 rounds from Ivan Drago and scream across the ring: "ADRIAN!"

creed_legacy.title: "Balboa's Heir"
creed_legacy.desc: Wrap your hands, take the baton from old Rocky, withstand the challenge from Ivan Drago's son and prove that the legacy is in good hands.

conjuring_universe.title: "Part-Time Exorcist"
conjuring_universe.desc: Survive all the jump scares and paranormal phenomena in haunted houses, help the Warrens hide another cursed doll and never go into the dark basement.

planet_of_apes.title: "Apes Together Strong!"
planet_of_apes.desc: Follow Caesar's journey from a lab primate to the leader of a new civilization, learn sign language and scream across the Golden Gate Bridge: "NO!"

kingsman_manners.title: "Manners Maketh Man"
kingsman_manners.desc: Order a perfect double-breasted suit from the tailor, go to a British pub, lock the door and elegantly beat up thugs with a bulletproof umbrella.

tv_firefly_browncoat.title: "Browncoat"
tv_firefly_browncoat.desc: Watch the cult space western, curse the Fox bosses, mark the cancellation date in your calendar and cry for the rest of your life at the sight of toy dinosaurs and phrases about "a leaf on the wind".

tv_walking_dead_coral.title: "CORAL!"
tv_walking_dead_coral.desc: Push through 11 seasons of endless crying, forest fights and soapy dialogue for 15 minutes of zombie action, learn the Carl meme and scream through the whole house: "CORAL!"

tv_lost_numbers.desc: Endure 6 seasons of mysteries, smoke monsters, bunkers and running around the island, enter the numbers into the terminal every 108 minutes, and at the finale sit with an empty head and ask one question: "And that's fucking it?!"

tv_prison_break_tattoo.title: "Map on the Ass"
tv_prison_break_tattoo.desc: Tattoo the blueprints of Fox River prison on your whole body, escape in the first season, and then spend 4 more seasons stepping on the same rake, escaping from other prisons, because Michael Scofield just can't sit at home.

tv_breaking_bad_cook.title: "Real Chemist"
tv_breaking_bad_cook.desc: Follow the transformation of a modest chemistry teacher in his underpants into the main drug lord of New Mexico, learn the chemical formula of blue meth and remember the main truth forever: "Yo, Bitch!"

tv_got_coffee_cup.title: "Starbucks Cup"
tv_got_coffee_cup.desc: Live 8 years for battles, dragons and intrigues of Westeros, survive the Red Wedding, and in season 8 burn from the farts over the script and find that forgotten coffee cup on Daenerys's table.

tv_supernatural_pie.title: "Impala Driver"
tv_supernatural_pie.desc: Kill 15 years of your life on a marathon of the Winchester brothers, listen to Carry On Wayward Son 500 times, die and resurrect with Sam and Dean at least 10 times and demand your pie!

tv_office_that_what_she_said.title: "That's what she said!"
tv_office_that_what_she_said.desc: Spend hundreds of hours in the company of Michael Scott and Dunder Mifflin, survive the most dexterous Spanish shame in the episode "Scott's Tots" and insert the joke "That's what she said" into absolutely any conversation.

tv_x_files_truth.title: "The Truth Is Out There"
tv_x_files_truth.desc: Immerse yourself in the paranoia of the 90s, whistle the cult theme on the intro, search for aliens and green men with Mulder while Scully with a stone face explains everything by swamp gases.

tv_sherlock_sociopath.title: "High-Functioning Sociopath"
tv_sherlock_sociopath.desc: Build a mind palace with Benedict Cumberbatch, examine dirt on boots with a microscope and wait 3 years for a new season while the authors get tangled in their own detective plots.

tv_sopranos_duck.title: "Member of the Soprano Family"
tv_sopranos_duck.desc: Take a psychotherapy course with Tony Soprano, feed the ducks in the pool, eat gabagool, learn the Italian profanity dialect and yell at the TV because of the sudden black screen at the very finale.

tv_twin_peaks_pie.title: "Damn Good Coffee!"
tv_twin_peaks_pie.desc: For 30 years figure out who the hell killed Laura Palmer, drink 100 cups of "damn good coffee", eat cherry pie, enter the Red Room and understand fuck all from David Lynch's season 3.

tv_friends_pivot.title: "FRIENDS: ETERNAL REPEAT"
tv_friends_pivot.desc: Watch all 10 seasons of the legendary sitcom, argue to a fight about "WE WERE ON A BREAK!", learn to carry a sofa screaming "PIVOT!" and play this show in the background while eating for the rest of your days.

tv_boys_compound_v.title: "Victim of Compound V"
tv_boys_compound_v.desc: See the true face of psychopathic supes, endure Homelander's laser eyes, giant penises, kilograms of guts and a meat grinder after which regular superhero cartoons seem like kindergarten.

tv_black_mirror_screen.title: "Looked into the Dark Screen"
tv_black_mirror_screen.desc: Watch technology break humanity, survive the very first wild episode about the prime minister and the pig, and after each episode sit in silence and look with horror at the turned-off screen of your smartphone.

tv_mandalorian_way.title: "This Is the Way"
tv_mandalorian_way.desc: Watch a stern mercenary in an iron mask work as a nanny for a green-eared baby, buy yourself a Baby Yoda figurine and repeat with a serious face to any life situation: "This is the Way".

tv_better_call_saul_lawyer.title: "Better Call Saul!"
tv_better_call_saul_lawyer.desc: Follow the path from a small-time con man Jimmy McGill to the lawyer of all Albuquerque gangsters, survive the drama of Chuck and the tape, sit through all 6 seasons and realize the spin-off turned out no worse than Breaking Bad.

tv_dexter_plastic_wrap.title: "Miami Hitchhiker"
tv_dexter_plastic_wrap.desc: Wrap the room in stretch film, study blood splatter on the wallpaper, punish bad guys with Dexter according to the Code of Harry and burst into tears at the finale with the lumberjack.

tv_peaky_blinders_by_order.title: "By Order of the Peaky Blinders!"
tv_peaky_blinders_by_order.desc: Buy a cap, walk slowly to the music of Red Right Hand, take a drag of a cigarette every 5 seconds, yell "BY ORDER OF THE PEAKY BLINDERS!" and pretend you're now a real gypsy gangster from Birmingham.

tv_chernobyl_not_great.title: "3.6 Roentgen — Not Great, Not Terrible"
tv_chernobyl_not_great.desc: Watch the best HBO miniseries, go deaf from the crackle of the dosimeter, learn the phrase about 3.6 roentgen and forever remember the price of lies.

tv_stranger_things_running_up.title: "Escape from Vecna"
tv_stranger_things_running_up.desc: Immerse yourself in the 80s vibe, play D&D in the basement, escape from the Upside Down to Kate Bush's Running Up That Hill and eat a pack of Eggo waffles.

tv_silicon_valley_middle_out.title: "Compression Algorithm"
tv_silicon_valley_middle_out.desc: Invent the Middle-Out algorithm, escape from Indian investors, survive 100 nervous breakdowns of Richard and understand how the Palo Alto IT scene really works.

tv_fargo_ok_then.title: "Aga, Ok Then"
tv_fargo_ok_then.desc: Start a bloody mess in snowy Minnesota, meet strange killers, hear the phrase "Aga, ok then" 500 times and wonder how ordinary stupidity leads to a mountain of corpses.

tv_arcane_league.title: "Tears of Zaun"
tv_arcane_league.desc: Watch the masterpiece animation from Riot Games, fall in love with the crazy Jinx, go deaf from the soundtrack and swear never to download League of Legends itself.

anime_konosuba_party.title: "Party of Idiots"
anime_konosuba_party.desc: Assemble a team of a useless alcoholic goddess, a maniac bomber with one spell a day and a masochist who cums from slaps, so that under the control of a nerdy owl with a panty fetish they accidentally save the world through the ass.

anime_pingpong_club.title: "Masters of Cringe and Degenerate Sports"
anime_pingpong_club.desc: Watch all episodes of this ancient masterpiece, get a lifelong psychological trauma from the local jokes of the 300 level and forever forget what normal, healthy ping-pong even looked like.

anime_prison_school.title: "Masters of Prison Shit-Mining"
anime_prison_school.desc: Go through all circles of school GULAG under the supervision of cruel whip-wielding wardens, where survival is built on absolute shame, escapes through toilets and proof that human dignity is an empty sound.

anime_redo_healer.title: "The Kindest Healer in the Area"
anime_redo_healer.desc: Watch all episodes of this exemplary hybrid of hard hentai and dark fantasy, where the protagonist 'heals' princesses and guards so hard that the viewer themselves should be sent to compulsory psychotherapy.

anime_death_note.title: "Battle of the Hunchbacked Schizophrenics"
anime_death_note.desc: Watch two genius autists play tennis for 35 episodes straight, eat strawberry cakes by the handful, sit on chairs with their feet up and build such multi-step schemes as if they were deciding the fate of the galaxy, not skipping class.

anime_nagatoro.title: "Toxic Pickup for Dummies"
anime_nagatoro.desc: Go through all circles of squinting, crimson cheeks, stuttering and mental slavery, watching how bullying of a downtrodden geek slowly but surely turns into sappy romance under the approving laughter of friends.

anime_elfen_lied.title: "Requiem for Dismembered Youth"
anime_elfen_lied.desc: Pick up a naked pink-haired girl with amnesia on the beach who only makes 'Nyu' sounds, and five minutes later start a bloody massacre with severed limbs and brains flying across the walls to the divine choral chanting of Lilium.

anime_higurashi.title: "Whirlpool of Schizophrenia"
anime_higurashi.desc: Go through all the sadistic arcs of this mental meat grinder, where every few episodes the timeline resets so you can watch your favorite girlfriends take turns going insane and start cutting each other with rusty knives again.

anime_chainsaw_man.title: "Meat Sandwich"
anime_chainsaw_man.desc: Sell your kidney, eye and conscience for the right to eat bread with jam, make a contract with a devil dog and turn into a walking chainsaw to die endlessly for a kiss.

anime_black_lagoon.title: "Lead Rain"
anime_black_lagoon.desc: Watch both seasons under the endless roar of heavy machine guns, mercenary curses, cigarette smoke and moral decay in a god-forsaken smuggler town.

anime_naruto_legend.title: "Legend of the Hidden Leaf"
anime_naruto_legend.desc: Sit through 700+ episodes for a great goal, but spend three hundred of them on mushroom battles, stupid dreams in a tent and memories of how Sasuke ate a tomato. At the end, scream 'dattebayo'!

anime_yani_neko.title: "Drug Cat"
anime_yani_neko.desc: Watch this acid indie trash under the acrid smell of tobacco, hopelessness, surreal pixels and endless nervous breakdowns at the bottom of everyday life.

anime_gurren_lagann.title: "Alpha Pathos"
anime_gurren_lagann.desc: Yell at the top of your lungs pathetic speeches about drilling the heavens, ride on the armor of a robot without a shirt and win any fight solely on the power of brotherly love and screams.

anime_toradora.title: "Tsundere Factory"
anime_toradora.desc: Spend 25 episodes in permanent Spanish shame, trying to set up two absolutely insane and blind slowpokes while you yourself are slowly but surely tied to this toxic kitchen.

anime_chi_sweet_home.title: "Cat Terror"
anime_chi_sweet_home.desc: Get an acute overdose of cloying cuteness, where the worst crime per season is accidentally peeing past the litter box or stealing a piece of fish.

anime_made_in_abyss.title: "Children's Minced Meat"
anime_made_in_abyss.desc: Watch a colorful cartoon about cute chibis that suddenly turns into a sophisticated festival of biopunk, dismemberment, psychological trauma and turning children into cutlery.

anime_mushoku_tensei.title: "Uncle from the Back Alley"
anime_mushoku_tensei.desc: Get transported to a fantasy world as a newborn baby, keeping the mind of a 34-year-old shut-in virgin, and immediately start groping your own nanny's panties with the face of a maniac.

anime_fullmetal_alchemist.title: "Coroner of the Year"
anime_fullmetal_alchemist.desc: Try to resurrect your dead mom with chalk, a circle and a couple of cans of chemicals, only to get a fleshy nightmare in return and pay with an arm, a leg and your brother.

anime_bleach.title: "Professional Recycler"
anime_bleach.desc: Die of boredom watching hundreds of filler episodes about some no-names invading, just so the main villain can be defeated in the arc finale by a single deus ex machina strike.

anime_sword_art_online.title: "Lord of Random"
anime_sword_art_online.desc: Get stuck in a VR game where dying in-game means a real coffin, but instead of grinding and surviving, quickly assemble a harem of schoolgirls and open a cafe in an alt-save.

anime_berserk.title: "Therapist with a Club"
anime_berserk.desc: Go through so much mental and physical abuse from the plot that even your personal demon guardian starts patting you on the shoulder sympathetically in the rain.

anime_count_10.title: "TV Tourist"
anime_count_10.desc: Barged into anime with your foot, watched Death Note, a couple of Miyazaki films and now think you've reached zen. You think everyone else is crazy, but you're already eyeing pink-haired waifus.

anime_count_50.title: "Desk Neighbor"
anime_count_50.desc: You can already tell Naruto from Bleach, stopped flinching at Japanese names, and confidently navigate school romance. Slowly giving up on real life and starting to order figures.

anime_count_150.title: "Hardened Otaku"
anime_count_150.desc: The boss has arrived. You know all the isekai cliches by heart, can lecture for hours about the quality of animation in fillers, and strictly watch everything only with subs, despising dubs.

anime_count_300.title: "Professional Night Owl"
anime_count_300.desc: Curtains drawn shut, the sun causes third-degree burns, and the last time you were outside was under President Yeltsin. Mom has stopped knocking when bringing dumplings to your PC.

anime_count_500.title: "Mental Samurai"
anime_count_500.desc: You've watched the entire backbone of the industry. Your brain has smoothly rebuilt itself to perceive Japanese humor, you get references to decade-old memes, and you sincerely await season 2 of Highschool of the Dead.

anime_count_750.title: "Insomnia Syndicate"
anime_count_750.desc: Sleep is for the weak. You binge three seasons a night, feed on energy drinks and chips, and your eyes glow brighter in the dark than a monitor with an open MyAnimeList.

anime_count_1000.title: "Archivist of the Abyss"
anime_count_1000.desc: Congratulations, bro, you've hit rock bottom. You know by heart all the passing isekai of 2014, remember the plots of fifty different school harems, and can quote villain monologues in Japanese (by sound).

anime_count_1500.title: "Anime Deity"
anime_count_1500.desc: Your soul has finally separated from your body and now resides somewhere on Crunchyroll servers. You've seen such shit and such masterpieces that you can no longer be shaken by any gore, glass, or isekai dad. You are a samurai without fear or reproach, whose room has turned into a temple of plastic waifus.

movie_count_10.title: "Popcorn Lover"
movie_count_10.desc: You enter the cinema club with blockbusters from the top of Kinopoisk. You know Marcellus Wallace from memes, Christopher Nolan from a dream within a dream, and if you turn on an art film without explosions, you fall asleep at the fifteenth minute.

movie_count_50.title: "Night Movie Night"
movie_count_50.desc: You confidently distinguish Scorsese from Spielberg, on Friday evenings you stock up on beer for thrillers with David Fincher, and you can already join the debate about who is cooler — Christian Bale's Batman or Ben Affleck's.

movie_count_150.title: "Sofa Critic"
movie_count_150.desc: Your room is littered with empty cans, and you're seriously lecturing in the comments about 'music video editing' and 'depth of metaphors' in yet another five-hour arthouse. You only go to cinemas with a serious face, judging popcorn munchers.

movie_count_300.title: "Lord of the Torrents"
movie_count_300.desc: You know by heart the filmographies of all 'New Wave' directors, download films in 4K Remux weighing 80 gigs via VPN, and look down on people for whom the pinnacle of cinema is 'Fast & Furious'.

movie_count_500.title: "Cinephile in Rehab"
movie_count_500.desc: Your hard drive is stuffed with black-and-white classics of the 40s, French existentialism, and Iranian dramas about boys on bicycles. You've long forgotten what the street smells like, and the sun irritates your retina.

movie_count_750.title: "Morgue Operator"
movie_count_750.desc: You've watched all the world cinema of category 'B', the trash shriekers of the seventies, body horror with polymer dismemberment, and festival arthouse where they silently stare at a wall for three hours. Your psyche is rolled in concrete.

movie_count_1000.title: "Matrix Architect"
movie_count_1000.desc: You know the plots of all existing scripts, guessing the ending from the first frame is a piece of cake for you, and you quote character dialogues in real life instead of normal words.

movie_count_1500.title: "Living Cinematograph"
movie_count_1500.desc: Your brain has completely turned into film. You exist outside of time and space, your life is divided into a three-act structure with a twist at the end. Reality itself seems to you like a dull cinematic with bad casting.

tv_count_10.title: "Pilot Dinner"
tv_count_10.desc: You sat down to watch a couple of episodes with dumplings and woke up at 3 AM saying 'just one more and then definitely sleep'. You know who Walter White is and sincerely believe you can stop at one season.

tv_count_50.title: "Weekend Marathoner"
tv_count_50.desc: You swallow entire seasons in one sitting. Your weekends are officially booked by streaming services, and the phrase 'skip intro' causes you genuine discomfort.

tv_count_150.title: "Cliffhanger Victim"
tv_count_150.desc: Your psyche is shaken by constant season finales where the main character is blown up in the last second. You sincerely hate the writers, but still turn on the next season at 4 AM before work.

tv_count_300.title: "Professional Couch Potato"
tv_count_300.desc: You remember the plots of all eight seasons of House M.D., can list all the babes from Supernatural, and seriously explain to your friends why the dumped finale of Game of Thrones is a personal trauma for your entire life.

tv_count_500.title: "Spoiler Catcher"
tv_count_500.desc: You don't go online the day before a new episode drops to avoid ruining your trip. Your life has turned into an endless release calendar, and friends are afraid to open their mouths around you in case they accidentally spoil a twist.

tv_count_750.title: "Serial Alcoholic"
tv_count_750.desc: You've rewatched everything: from gloomy British detective shows where they search for a missing sock for three seasons, to 80-episode Korean dramas about the love of a rich man and a poor waitress. Closing your eyes means missing an important plot thread.

tv_count_1000.title: "Master of Binge Watching"
tv_count_1000.desc: You don't just watch — you live at 1.5x and 2x speed. Your brain has learned to process four storylines at once, and the reflected light from the laptop screen is forever frozen in your eyes.

tv_count_1500.title: "Living Netflix"
tv_count_1500.desc: Congratulations, bro, you've devoured your entire real life for the sake of others' virtual stories. You remember every 90s sitcom, all soap operas and procedural fillers. Your room is a film set, and you've long been waiting for the renewal of your own season.

movie_bond.title: "British Gentleman"
movie_bond.desc: Change the faces of 007 agents, but keep three things unchanged: the signature martini (shaken, not stirred), a pile of corpses behind you, and a wrecked Aston Martin.

movie_avatar.title: "Blue Collector"
movie_avatar.desc: Make the internet joke for 15 years that "nobody remembers the names of the Avatar characters", then release a sequel and collect three billion bucks again on beautiful blue graphics.

movie_brat.title: "Brotherly Showdown"
movie_brat.desc: Quote the cult Balabanov dilogy about the power of truth and rotten Americans, buy chunky knit sweaters, and sincerely believe that Danila Bagrov would approve of your vibe.

movie_xmen.title: "Unfinished Retcon"
movie_xmen.desc: Confuse the timeline so much that even the writers have no idea in what year Wolverine lost his memory, why Professor Xavier walks, dies, and goes bald again in turns.

movie_taken.title: "Hollywood's Main Thug"
movie_taken.desc: Rebrand dramatic actor Liam Neeson as a grandpa killer who calls Albanian bandits on a flip phone in every part and promises to stab them.

movie_bumer.title: "Gopnik Quote Book"
movie_bumer.desc: Sell a million polyphonic ringtones for button phones and make all the 2000s schoolkids scream "That's not who we are, that's just life" in unison during breaks.

movie_home_alone.title: "New Year Sadist"
movie_home_alone.desc: You rewatch this every December with mandarins, rooting not for the kid, but for the burglars who by the laws of physics should have died from a fractured skull in the first ten minutes.

movie_wrong_turn.title: "Hellish Resort"
movie_wrong_turn.desc: You will never in your life turn onto a forest dirt road in the middle of nowhere, because you know: a family of inbred cannibals with cleavers is already waiting for you there.

movie_red.title: "Retired Secret Agent"
movie_red.desc: You laugh at how a gang of pensioners led by Bruce Willis and Helen Mirren with machine guns destroys an elite special forces unit over morning coffee.

movie_jaws.title: "Sea Trip"
movie_jaws.desc: You get a panic attack and remember John Williams' ominous two-note theme every time you go into water deeper than your knee.

movie_kick_ass.title: "Paper Genocide"
movie_kick_ass.desc: You cringe and admire at the same time how a little girl in a purple wig under cheerful music minces the mafia into meat with knives and a bazooka.

movie_riddick.title: "Space Dumpster"
movie_riddick.desc: Evolution of the year: start with a cozy niche horror about a bald criminal with a knife and a cup, then ride into a three-hour space opera with necromongers and a hundred-million-dollar budget, so everyone sits there in awe of the abrupt genre shift.

movie_28_days.title: "Dead Season"
movie_28_days.desc: A turning point in the genre, when Danny Boyle shot an empty London on a cheap digital camera to eerie post-rock and made zombies run at Olympic sprinter speed, burying slow zombies of the past century forever.

movie_jurassic.title: "Toothy Arithmetic"
movie_jurassic.desc: The brilliant business plan of an entire era: pour billions into an island with genetically modified lizards, save on security and sysadmins, and then watch for three hours as a T-Rex eats lawyers to John Williams' orchestral epic.

movie_jeepers.title: "Toothy Province"
movie_jeepers.desc: An endless search for trouble on abandoned American highways, where an ancient winged monster crawls out once every twenty years to eat stupid teenagers, while fans pray that this series is forgotten like a bad dream.

movie_bttf.title: "Time Loop on a DeLorean"
movie_bttf.desc: The quintessential sci-fi by Robert Zemeckis, where a mad professor and a guy in a denim jacket ride through decades, and the perfect script and 80s atmosphere never age at all.

movie_police_academy.title: "Parade of Freaks in Uniforms"
movie_police_academy.desc: The main reason why all the 2000s yard kids wanted to learn to imitate machine gun sounds like John Jones, laughed their asses off at the Blue Oyster Bar, and memorized Mahoney's antics. Tu-turu-tu-tu-tu.

movie_nightmare.title: "Sleepy Nightmare"
movie_nightmare.desc: Real psychological terror from your childhood, because of which you were afraid to stick your leg out from under the blanket at night, flinched at every rusty basement, and understood the hopelessness of existence: this burned pedophile in a striped rag will still get you in your sleep, no matter how you hide.

movie_hobbit.title: "Graphical Burn"
movie_hobbit.desc: A mad attraction of greed, when a short children's fairy tale was stretched into three three-hour fillers, everything was smeared with soapy CGI plastic, dwarf noses were drawn in on computers, and everyone was forced to watch endless graphical crap instead of the good old soulful magic.

movie_die_hard.title: "Christmas Nut"
movie_die_hard.desc: Remember how this movie replaced New Year fairy tales for you in childhood: blood, broken glass, a sweaty cop and Hans Gruber flying off a skyscraper. Pure delight. It's just a pity that in the end the story about a sweaty unshaven cop was turned into a soapy circus with computer explosions.

movie_gruz_200.title: "Cargo 200"
movie_gruz_200.desc: Congratulations, you've officially lost two hours of mental health. Rest in peace, Aleksei Balabanov, and condolences to your nerves.

movie_human_centipede.title: "The Human Centipede"
movie_human_centipede.desc: Sewing mastery of the level of "God". Now you know more about digestion than a gastroenterologist.

movie_salo.title: "Salò, or the 120 Days of Sodom"
movie_salo.desc: An Italian classic that everyone recommends but nobody fucking finishes. You're either a pervert or a schizophrenic film critic.

movie_serbian_film.title: "A Serbian Film"
movie_serbian_film.desc: Family movie for Saturday night. After this, your ex will seem like an angel to you.

movie_eraserhead.title: "Eraserhead"
movie_eraserhead.desc: The hum of radiators and a mutant chicken in the sink. Lynch was smoking some fierce shit, and now you've joined in.

movie_pink_flamingos.title: "Pink Flamingos"
movie_pink_flamingos.desc: Holy saints, dog shit in the frame is just the beginning. Your stomach is officially hardened with tar.

movie_antichrist.title: "Antichrist"
movie_antichrist.desc: Nature is calling from the forest and asking to take this madness back. Von Trier sends you warm greetings through a therapist.

movie_das_experiment.title: "Das Experiment"
movie_das_experiment.desc: Executioners and victims have swapped places, and you're sitting there thinking: "Why the fuck did I even turn this on?"

movie_dogtooth.title: "Dogtooth"
movie_dogtooth.desc: A family where a cat is a scary beast and the fence is the end of the world. Healthy relationships of a healthy person.

movie_under_the_skin.title: "Under the Skin"
movie_under_the_skin.desc: Two hours of staring at an alien woman drowning men in black goo to ambient music. Art, fuck!

movie_holy_mountain.title: "The Holy Mountain"
movie_holy_mountain.desc: Alchemy, naked alchemists, shit in jars plated with gold, and a complete absence of logic. Acid nervously smokes on the sidelines.

movie_twin_peaks_fire.title: "Twin Peaks: Fire Walk with Me"
movie_twin_peaks_fire.desc: Bob screams from the mirror, the owls are not what they seem, and only one question spins in your head: "Where's my coffee?"

movie_pi.title: "Pi"
movie_pi.desc: A guy drills his own brain with a drill because of numbers. Almost like you when you try to debug your movie tracker.

movie_dead_man.title: "Dead Man"
movie_dead_man.desc: "You are dead, William Blake." And you're dead too, if you made it through this slow metaphysical trip to the end credits.

movie_sexual_parasite.title: "Sexual Parasite"
movie_sexual_parasite.desc: The title sounds like a Z-category porno parody shot on an intercom camera in a basement for a bottle of beer, but it's pure Japanese arthouse madness. Your brain has been officially raped by Japanese geniuses.

movie_cannibal_holocaust.title: "Cannibal Holocaust"
movie_cannibal_holocaust.desc: The turtles are in shock, the cameraman is in prison, and you're sitting there with a straight face at three in the morning.

movie_hard_to_be_god.title: "Hard to Be a God"
movie_hard_to_be_god.desc: Three hours of fucking dirt, grunting, and medieval life. Pure cinematographic fetishism.

movie_five_bottles.title: "Five Bottles of Vodka"
movie_five_bottles.desc: Pure philosophical madness and existential pain from vocational school graduates who imagine themselves as Tarkovsky. After this, your depression leaves the chat because it's ashamed to compete with this mess.

movie_toxic_avenger.title: "The Toxic Avenger"
movie_toxic_avenger.desc: A guy got dunked head-first into toxic waste and became a superhero with a mop, mowing down scumbags left and right. Quintessential 80s trash where tits, guts, and acid humor are mixed in perfect proportion.

movie_blood_feast.title: "Blood Feast"
movie_blood_feast.desc: The fake blood looks like raspberry syrup, the actors perform worse than a stool, and director Herschell Gordon Lewis invented guts on screen long before it became mainstream. Historical shit, fuck!

status_planned_10.title: "Watch Later List"
status_planned_10.desc: Added 10 titles to "Planned". Started — now all that's left is finding the time.

status_planned_50.title: "Eternal List"
status_planned_50.desc: 50 titles in "Planned". You already understand that watching everything is impossible, but you keep adding.

status_planned_100.title: "Promise Collector"
status_planned_100.desc: 100 titles in "Planned". You promised yourself to watch them all. You're lying.

status_planned_300.title: "Archive of Unfulfilled"
status_planned_300.desc: 300 titles in "Planned". This is no longer a list, it's a graveyard of hopes.

status_on_hold_10.title: "Postponed"
status_on_hold_10.desc: 10 titles in "On Hold". Not exactly dropped, but not watched either.

status_on_hold_50.title: "Master of Pause"
status_on_hold_50.desc: 50 titles in "On Hold". You can pause not only movies but life too.

status_on_hold_100.title: "Frozen Collection"
status_on_hold_100.desc: 100 titles in "On Hold". Your library looks like a warehouse with a "later" sign.

status_dropped_10.title: "First Drop"
status_dropped_10.desc: 10 titles in "Dropped". You're not afraid to admit it wasn't for you.

status_dropped_50.title: "No Regrets"
status_dropped_50.desc: 50 titles in "Dropped". You know when to stop. Some people don't.

status_dropped_100.title: "Title Graveyard"
status_dropped_100.desc: 100 titles in "Dropped". You don't drop, you bury.

tv_wire_streets.title: Elite Nervous System Dissection
tv_wire_streets.desc: Stringer, Marlo and endless cops on the wire. The smartest show you fell asleep to four times.

tv_succession_boar.title: Rich People Cry Too (Fuck Off)
tv_succession_boar.desc: Twenty hours straight of rich old men in expensive suits telling you to fuck off. Go watch more.

tv_last_of_us_clicker.title: Mushroom Soup from Pedro
tv_last_of_us_clicker.desc: A video game adaptation that didn't suck? What the fuck. Waiting for Pedro to lose his adopted daughter again.

tv_dark_loop.title: German Mindfuck with a Loop
tv_dark_loop.desc: "Everything is connected". Who is whose grandpa, nephew, and grandson? Your brain burned out in episode 2, but you pretended to get it.

tv_leftovers_departure.title: Existential Mindfuck
tv_leftovers_departure.desc: Everyone just vanished, and the leftovers walk around with sour faces. Philosophy level: "I fell and I can't get up".

tv_true_detective_flat_circle.title: Rust Cohle's Pessimism
tv_true_detective_flat_circle.desc: Time is a flat circle, and life is meaningless shit. But the intro and cinematography are sex.

tv_fargo_oh_geez.title: Oh Geez, Corpse in the Meat Grinder
tv_fargo_oh_geez.desc: "Oh geez", a corpse in a meat grinder, and stubborn cops. Minnesota never seemed so fucked up.

tv_sense8_psychic.title: Orgiastic Cyberpunk
tv_sense8_psychic.desc: Eight people feel each other's pain. Especially when the writers' minds go crazy.

tv_taboo_hardy.title: Tom Hardy Growls
tv_taboo_hardy.desc: Two hours of Tom just walking around London with shitty stubble and terrifying everyone. Life.

tv_mare_easttown.title: Beer Depression
tv_mare_easttown.desc: Beer, snot, family affairs, smoking on the porch, and shattered hopes. A classic Monday.

tv_sharp_objects.title: Southern Gothic and Trauma
tv_sharp_objects.desc: Southern gothic, alcoholism, and mental trauma. You urgently want a shower after watching.

tv_mr_robot_hello_friend.title: Hacker in a Balaclava
tv_mr_robot_hello_friend.desc: "Hello, friend". You're either a hacker in a balaclava or a schizophrenic talking to a chair.

tv_foundation_empire.title: Mathematicians vs. Empire
tv_foundation_empire.desc: The empire is crumbling, mathematicians argue, and you're trying not to fall asleep during three-hour dialogues in glass scenery.

tv_andor_rebellion.title: Star Wars for Adults
tv_andor_rebellion.desc: Political intrigue, prison riots, and grumpy uncles. Turns out Star Wars can exist without Jedi and cringe.

tv_sen_cal_kapimi.title: Turkish Nonsense for 200 Episodes
tv_sen_cal_kapimi.desc: The main character's abs are sharper than your bread knife. Grandma is happy, your masculinity is undermined.

tv_good_omens_angel_demon.title: Gay Drama Amidst the Apocalypse
tv_good_omens_angel_demon.desc: Two old men set up a gay drama against the backdrop of the end of the world. Your inner fanfic fan is rejoicing.

tv_white_lotus_resort.title: Suffering of Rich Snobs
tv_white_lotus_resort.desc: An elite vacation turns into a parade of hypocrisy and corpses. The bourgeoisie have it bad too, but at our expense.

tv_yellowstone_ranch.title: Cowboys with Shotguns
tv_yellowstone_ranch.desc: Lots of horses, cowboy hats, and shooting at neighbors. Your inner farming urge is activated.

tv_american_gods_acid.title: Acid Trip
tv_american_gods_acid.desc: Old gods suck their paws, new gods are smartphones and the internet. Stylish, trendy, understandable as fuck all.

tv_in_treatment_couch.title: Therapy Session
tv_in_treatment_couch.desc: Fifty minutes of other people's mental problems. You don't have enough of your own, so chew on someone else's.

tv_himym_bro_code.title: Ruined Ending
tv_himym_bro_code.desc: You listened to an old man's boring story for nine years just to find out he ran back to Aunt Robin anyway. Classic troll father-in-law.

tv_bbt_bazinga.title: Bazinga
tv_bbt_bazinga.desc: Every time Sheldon says "Bazinga", your IQ drops by 5 points. But you kept watching.

tv_b99_noice.title: Noice
tv_b99_noice.desc: Terry loves yogurt, Jake acts like a dumbass, and Captain Holt doesn't blink. The best precinct in the neighborhood.

tv_parks_ron_swanson.title: Meat and Waffles
tv_parks_ron_swanson.desc: Ron Swanson approves of your meat, Leslie Knope — of your waffles. Bureaucracy has never been this hilarious.

tv_community_greendale.title: Six Seasons and a Movie
tv_community_greendale.desc: You officially know your way around meta-irony and insane Christmas episodes.

tv_modern_family_dunphy.title: Phil Dunphy Is Your Dad
tv_modern_family_dunphy.desc: Phil Dunphy is your spiritual dad, and Claire is a walking heart attack. The perfect American dream with a twist.

tv_scrubs_eagle.title: Eagle!
tv_scrubs_eagle.desc: "Eagle!", the grumpy Janitor, and tears during the final song. You grew up on this show, old man.

tv_always_sunny_gang.title: Worst People on Earth
tv_always_sunny_gang.desc: No morals, pure schizophrenia, screaming, and degradation. The nicest sitcom about the worst people on Earth.

tv_fawlty_towers_cringe.title: Don't Tread on My Foot
tv_fawlty_towers_cringe.desc: Your hand won't leave your face from the second episode. The British joke so hard it makes your teeth ache.

tv_office_uk_cringe.title: Office Cringe
tv_office_uk_cringe.desc: Your hand won't leave your face from the second episode. The British joke so hard it makes your teeth ache.

tv_silicon_valley_pied_piper.title: Urine Compression
tv_silicon_valley_pied_piper.desc: Urine compression algorithm, lawsuits over the "average weight" patent, and Erlich Bachman sucking on a hookah. Real IT life.

tv_two_half_men_charlie.title: Womanizing Alcoholic
tv_two_half_men_charlie.desc: Charlie Sheen drank, played piano, and banged models before it was mainstream. Golden cable classic.

tv_good_place_kant.title: Kantian Philosophy with Beer
tv_good_place_kant.desc: Holy shrimp! You're in heaven, even though you've been a bastard in life. Kantian philosophy with beer.

tv_bojack_horseman.title: Depressed Horse
tv_bojack_horseman.desc: An anthropomorphic horse suffers from depression better than you. Congrats, you've found a mirror to your soul.

tv_key_peele_ayy.title: Ayy-ayy-ayy!
tv_key_peele_ayy.desc: "Ayy-ayy-ayy!" — you scream when you remember American football players' names. Pure kekable.

tv_wwdits_vampires.title: Hipster Vampires
tv_wwdits_vampires.desc: Batou, Laszlo, and Colin Robinson (an energy vampire that makes you want to hang yourself). Immortal alcoholics' life in all its glory.

tv_ted_lasso_believe.title: Ultimate Optimism
tv_ted_lasso_believe.desc: An American football coach teaches Brits to play soccer using biscuits. That level of kindness made your teeth ache.

tv_after_life_jervey.title: Life on Max
tv_after_life_jervey.desc: Wife died, nothing to lose, so now you can be rude to every bastard you meet. Life on max.

tv_fleabag_camera.title: Look at the Camera
tv_fleabag_camera.desc: British humor, existential mindfuck, and a hot priest. The perfect recipe for ruining your own life.

tv_the_bear_kitchen.title: Give Me Sandwiches!
tv_the_bear_kitchen.desc: "Herd, fuck you! Give me sandwiches!". After this show, working at a factory will seem like a sanatorium to you.

tv_monty_python_inquisition.title: Spanish Inquisition
tv_monty_python_inquisition.desc: Nobody expects the Spanish Inquisition! Your brain is officially broken from walking the line.

tv_csi_evidence.title: UV Lamp
tv_csi_evidence.desc: Shined a blue flashlight, shined it on semen — the criminal is found. 2000s tech that makes modern experts' asses burn.

tv_mentalist_blink.title: Guess by the Blink
tv_mentalist_blink.desc: Smiled, drank tea, solved 15 secret conspiracies in 40 minutes. Patrick Jane is the daddy of mentalism, Red John can suck it.

tv_bones_skeleton.title: Decomposition of 100+ Skeletons
tv_bones_skeleton.desc: Licking skulls, anthropology on fingers, and romance over a decomposed corpse from a swamp.

tv_criminal_minds_profile.title: Psychotype of 50 Maniacs
tv_criminal_minds_profile.desc: Now you know that any quiet neighbor collecting stamps actually keeps three people in his basement.

tv_fringe_walter.title: Acid and Cows
tv_fringe_walter.desc: Acid, parallel worlds, cows in the lab, and LSD with a cup of tea. X-Files on steroids.

tv_hannibal_dinner.title: Exquisite Cuisine
tv_hannibal_dinner.desc: Aesthetics, cinematography, and meat of unknown origin. After this show, supermarket mincemeat raises questions.

tv_castle_writer.title: Writer Gets in Cops' Way
tv_castle_writer.desc: He just came to troll and bang the detective, but ended up solving half of New York's crimes.

tv_bsg_so_say_we_all.title: So Say We All
tv_bsg_so_say_we_all.desc: Are we Cylons or not?! Military space, drama, paranoia, and the phrase "So say we all" that gives you goosebumps on your balls.

tv_doctor_who_tardis.title: Blue Box
tv_doctor_who_tardis.desc: Blue box, sonic screwdriver, and cardboard aliens from the 60s. The most fucked up and greatest sci-fi in history.

tv_star_trek_picard.title: Facepalm with Picard
tv_star_trek_picard.desc: Diplomacy in space, teleportation, and phasers. You've officially joined the old-timer Trekkie club.

tv_expanse_protomolecule.title: Real Physics in Space
tv_expanse_protomolecule.desc: Gravity painfully hits your kidneys, asteroid belts rebel, and the protomolecule mutates its own shit. Realism, bitch.

tv_stargate_ring.title: Giant Water Ring
tv_stargate_ring.desc: Gods are just aliens with worms in their heads. Peter Griffin and Colonel O'Neill say hi.

tv_resident_alien_tudyk.title: Alan Tudyk Pretends to Be a Doctor
tv_resident_alien_tudyk.desc: An alien learns human language from sitcoms and tries not to kill a little kid who can see him. Pure kek.

tv_orville_macfarlane.title: Parody Better Than the Original
tv_orville_macfarlane.desc: Jokes about alien asses smoothly transition into brutal space drama. Seth knows how, when he wants to.

tv_simpsons_seasons.title: Future Predictors
tv_simpsons_seasons.desc: Homer drinks Duff, Bart writes on the board, and the writers guessed the future 20 years ahead again. Masons are resting.

tv_south_park_seasons.title: They Killed Kenny
tv_south_park_seasons.desc: They killed Kenny! You bastards! Humor on the edge of a criminal code article, which is why we love Matt and Trey.

tv_family_guy_seasons.title: Cutaway Gag
tv_family_guy_seasons.desc: Remember when Peter fought the giant chicken? Yeah, we remember too. Absurdity level: "hold my beer".

tv_futurama_seasons.title: Seymour the Dog
tv_futurama_seasons.desc: Bender with a shiny metal ass and the tears of a thirty-year-old man over a loyal dog. Painful, bitch.

tv_american_dad_seasons.title: 400 Roger Costumes
tv_american_dad_seasons.desc: Roger changed 400 costumes, got drunk, got high, and saved the world. The best animation character.

tv_king_of_hill_seasons.title: Propane and Propane Accessories
tv_king_of_hill_seasons.desc: Yup. Mm-hmm. The life of simple rednecks from Texas without unnecessary fuss. Pure boomer joy.

tv_bojack_horseman.title: Five Wagons of Depression
tv_bojack_horseman.desc: You thought it was a comedy? Here are five wagons of depression, alcoholism, and loneliness. Enjoy.

tv_archer_danger_zone.title: Danger Zone!
tv_archer_danger_zone.desc: An alcoholic special agent with an Oedipus complex destroys everything he touches.

tv_twilight_zone.title: Grandfather of TV Mystery
tv_twilight_zone.desc: Black-and-white plot twists that make Black Mirror shyly smoke on the sidelines. 50s classic.

tv_ahs_switch.title: Three Setting Changes
tv_ahs_switch.desc: Evan Peters and Sarah Paulson are screaming again, and Ryan Murphy mixes stylish horror with total chaos.

tv_twin_peaks_s3.title: Episode 8 Without Doping
tv_twin_peaks_s3.desc: Atomic explosion, black-and-white bugs, Dougie Jones, and "Gotta light?". David Lynch finally shit in everyone's brains.

tv_inside_no9_twist.title: Twist at the End
tv_inside_no9_twist.desc: One room, two actors, and a plot twist that leaves you sitting with your mouth open for ten minutes.

tv_heroes_save_cheerleader.title: Save the Cheerleader
tv_heroes_save_cheerleader.desc: The first season is a legend and a masterpiece. Everything after — forget it like a bad dream, it never existed.

tv_grimm_wesen.title: True Faces of Creatures
tv_grimm_wesen.desc: Wolves, creatures, and ancient books. Brothers Grimm fairy tales retold by the Mentals in the neighborhood.

anime_ghibli_miyazaki.title: Ghibli
anime_ghibli_miyazaki.desc: Holy spirits, a walking castle on chicken legs, and eating sweets until you puke. After this you want to quit your job and go live in the forest with the forest gods.

anime_evangelion.title: Clap-Clap, Emo Kid!
anime_evangelion.desc: Congrats, you watched a spinning pillar for 30 minutes while a depressed teen screamed, and everyone clapped at the end. You understood nothing but felt it.

anime_cowboy_bebop.title: Smoky Space
anime_cowboy_bebop.desc: See you, space cowboy… Now sit in an empty room to Space Lion and think about your worthless life.

anime_trigun.title: Pacifist with a Machine Gun
anime_trigun.desc: A man with a 60 billion double-dollar bounty who just wants to eat donuts. Love and peace, bitch!

anime_gits_1995.title: Fight in Your Birthday Suit
anime_gits_1995.desc: Major Kusanagi doesn't even need clothes to blow your mind with musings on what a soul is in a world of wires.

anime_akira.title: Goodbye, My Clutch!
anime_akira.desc: Tetsuooooo! Kanedaaaaa! The legendary bike drift under the screams of a mutating brute.

anime_ghibli_miyazaki.title: Grandpa Won't Hold Back the Pension
anime_ghibli_miyazaki.desc: Holy spirits, a walking castle on chicken legs, and eating sweets until you puke. After this, you want to quit your job and live in the forest with the forest gods.

anime_perfect_blue.title: Paranoia Behind the Scenes
anime_perfect_blue.desc: Nolan's thrillers smoke in the corner while the 3D brain of a pop singer melts from stalkers.

anime_hellsing_ultimate.title: Nighttime Disinfector
anime_hellsing_ultimate.desc: "Bitches from the Millennium battalion, heel!" Tekken style, rivers of blood, and a sea of pathos.

anime_samurai_champloo.title: Edo-Era Breakdance
anime_samurai_champloo.desc: Breakdancing with katanas, the stench of sake, and dumb arguments between a samurai and a hip-hopper.

anime_fma_2003.title: Exchange Rate Not by the Central Bank
anime_fma_2003.desc: The version where the ending is a pure emotional wound and tears on a rainy bridge.

anime_grave_fireflies.title: Emotional Cripple
anime_grave_fireflies.desc: The only thing worse than a bombing raid is watching this anime. You'll never put it on again, promise.

anime_gantz.title: Let's Assemble a Puzzle from Meat
anime_gantz.desc: Naked girls, ugly aliens, a meat grinder, and a complete lack of morals.

anime_monster.title: Doctor with a Savior Complex
anime_monster.desc: Johan Liebert didn't even say a word, and half of Europe has already gone mad.

anime_paranoia_agent.title: Sports Equipment Right to the Forehead
anime_paranoia_agent.desc: Social satire, flying hoodies, and mass psychosis. Satoshi Kon masterfully shat on your rose-colored glasses.

anime_rurouni_kenshin.title: Dangerous Patient on the Loose
anime_rurouni_kenshin.desc: A whiny samurai turns into a ruthless daddy at the sight of enemies.

anime_claymore.title: Unfinished Clinic
anime_claymore.desc: Monsters eat people, girls slash monsters, and the manga was never properly adapted to the end.

anime_wolfs_rain.title: Wandering Orderlies
anime_wolfs_rain.desc: Snow, post-apocalypse, edgy wolves in human form, and endless fillers.

anime_ergo_proxy.title: Philosophy Under Depression
